source: Every live bespoke line (review/set-001-lines-bespoke-final.json) whose English or Afrikaans names a place or region, plus the two untagged lines naming the southeaster. Tags from assets/hero-lines.js HERO_LINE_TAGS; Afrikaans from assets/hero-lines-af.js; boxes from assets/geo-regions.js.
trigger: Strand, 23 Sept 2026: "Joburg drivers are panicking already." captioned a rain photograph (rain/week_2/day/3.webp).

excluded.note: Named but not a region question: the whole app is South African, or the name is not a place a viewer can stand in.
lines: This is why we live in South Africa.
Some clouds. Some sun. South African summer admin.
The sky is threatening, the firelighters are answering: a very South African standoff.
Rain turns every South African driver back into a learner. Hazards on, dignity off.
Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
In the sun: bearable. Two steps left: Antarctica.
Clouds are crying like NZ at the 23 Rugby WC!
Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.
Not a cloud. Just you and the Southern Cross.
The Southern Cross is out and the lawn has gone silver under it.
The Southern Cross is out, and so is the frost. Package deal.

verdicts.KEEP: untagged: the line shows anywhere its photograph does (on an already-tagged row this lifts the tag)
verdicts.TAG: the proposed region becomes the line’s tag; a line that is also a condition-bank line takes the tag in the bank too (all five languages share the bank row’s tag), and the bespoke copy inherits it
verdicts.CUT: the line comes off every photograph (English and Afrikaans); a line that is also a condition-bank line leaves the bank in all five languages

rows.en: Joburg drivers are panicking already.
rows.af: Joburg-bestuurders paniek al klaar.
rows.note: On screen at Strand, 23 Sept 2026. Photo: rain on a windscreen, traffic, hills behind; nothing in it says Joburg.

rows.en: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by supper.
rows.af: Joburg somerreën: kom vyfuur, deurweek alles, weg teen aandete.
rows.note: Photo: the Joburg skyline in rain from a balcony, so it is a caption; "Joburg rains for twenty minutes…" on the same photograph is tagged gauteng, and TAG keeps them consistent. It also says summer; season is not this page's question.

rows.en: Jacaranda blossom and stormwater, which is Joburg's least favourite combination.
rows.af: Jakarandablomme en stormwater — die kombinasie waarvan Joburg die minste hou.
rows.note: Photo: a rainy suburban street at night; nothing in it says Joburg.

rows.en: The sky has gone the colour that makes Joburg check the group chat.
rows.af: Die lug het die kleur geword wat Joburg na die group chat laat kyk.
rows.note: Photo: a windy suburban street under grey sky; nothing in it says Joburg.

rows.en: Not one cloud, not one degree: a Highveld winter morning doing both at once.
rows.af: Nie een wolk nie, nie een graad nie: 'n Hoëveldse wintermôre doen albei gelyk.
rows.note: Photo: a cyclist on a frosty tree-lined road; nothing in it says Highveld.

rows.en: Breath like smoke, frost on the glass, sun already out: Highveld school run.
rows.af: Asem soos rook, ryp op die glas, son reeds op: Hoëveldse skoolrit.
rows.note: Photo: a dad and son at a bakkie on a frosty morning; nothing in it says Highveld.

rows.en: Blue sky, gold grass, white edges: a Highveld rugby morning in full kit.
rows.af: Blou lug, goue gras, wit rande: 'n Hoëveldse rugbyoggend in volle drag.
rows.note: Photo: rugby posts on a frosty field; nothing in it says Highveld.

rows.en: A clear dusk on the Highveld is just the frost clearing its throat.
rows.af: 'n Helder skemer op die Hoëveld is net die ryp wat sy keel skoonmaak.
rows.note: Photo: a dog at a gate at frosty dusk; nothing in it says Highveld.

rows.en: Highveld rain doesn’t arrive. It gets delivered — all at once, one farm at a time.
rows.af: Hoëveldse reën kom nie aan nie. Dit word afgelewer — alles tegelyk, een plaas op 'n slag.
rows.note: Photo: a rain shaft over a farmhouse on flat farmland; nothing in it says Highveld.

rows.en: A Free State storm gives you exactly as much warning as it feels like.
rows.af: 'n Vrystaatse storm gee jou presies soveel waarskuwing soos wat hy lus het.
rows.note: Photo: lightning over a suburban street; nothing in it says Free State.

rows.en: Overcast this thick turns the Karoo into a corridor, and he is halfway down it.
rows.af: Wolke só dik maak van die Karoo 'n gang, en hy is halfpad daarin af.
rows.note: Photo: a bakkie's headlights on a dark road; nothing in it says Karoo.

rows.en: Frost right up to the dam wall: the Karoo did its winter thing overnight.
rows.af: Ryp tot teen die damwal: die Karoo het oornag sy winterding gedoen.
rows.note: Photo: a windpump on frosty veld. The same photograph carries a Highveld line (gauteng) and a Free State line (free-state), so it reads as any platteland.

rows.en: Full sun, visible breath: the Karoo running both seasons before lunch.
rows.af: Vol son, sigbare asem: die Karoo speel albei seisoene af voor middagete.
rows.note: Photo: an old farmer on a white wall over flat veld. "Karoo morning…" on the same photograph is already tagged karoo; TAG keeps the pair consistent, KEEP treats it as a caption.

rows.en: Northern Cape wind does not howl. It leans on things until they give.
rows.af: Noord-Kaapse wind huil nie. Hy leun op goed tot hulle meegee.
rows.note: Photo: an aloe and a thorn tree in blowing dust. geo-regions.js has no Northern Cape box; karoo is the nearest and covers the southern Northern Cape, not Upington or the Kalahari. A region with no box fails open and shows everywhere.

rows.en: Even the Capetonians are admitting it's cold.
rows.af: Selfs die Kapenaars erken dit is koud.
rows.note: Photo: a man bracing against the cold on a wet suburban street; nothing in it says Cape Town.

rows.en: Cape Town is still on under there; the fog is just running interference.
rows.af: Kaapstad is nog aan daaronder; die mis staan net in die pad.
rows.note: Photo: Cape Town from above at night under fog, so it is a caption; but "Cape Town just got a dimmer switch." on the same photograph is tagged, and TAG keeps the pair consistent.

rows.en: Wednesday, and the Cape Doctor is doing its rounds a little early.
rows.af: Woensdag, en die Kaapse Dokter doen sy rondtes 'n bietjie vroeg.
rows.note: Names the wind blowing where you are. The western-cape box started life as app.js's Cape Doctor box, and "The Cape Doctor is making house calls." is already tagged.

rows.en: The Cape Doctor is on night shift. The whole street has an appointment.
rows.af: Die Kaapse Dokter werk nagskof. Die hele straat het 'n afspraak.
rows.note: Names the wind blowing where you are. The other Cape Doctor line is already tagged western-cape.

rows.en: Nobody on this side of Gqeberha is hanging washing out today.
rows.af: Niemand aan hierdie kant van Gqeberha hang vandag wasgoed op nie.
rows.note: Photo: a windy coastal street with a flag; nothing in it says Gqeberha.

rows.en: Wednesday this warm turns every roof in Joburg into a second office.
rows.af: 'n Woensdag só warm maak van elke dak in Joburg 'n tweede kantoor.
rows.note: Photo: two women working on a Joburg rooftop, Hillbrow Tower behind. A caption.

rows.en: Joburg does about three hundred of these a year. Nobody is complaining.
rows.af: Joburg kry omtrent driehonderd van hierdie 'n jaar. Niemand kla nie.
rows.note: Photo: a rooftop party in front of the Joburg skyline. A caption.

rows.en: That mug is steaming because Joburg mornings under cloud start at about four degrees.
rows.af: Daardie beker stoom, want in Joburg begin bewolkte oggende by omtrent vier grade.
rows.note: Photo: a Joburg street at dawn, Hillbrow Tower behind. A caption.

rows.en: Looks like a tourism ad. Feels like the inside of a fridge.
rows.af: Joburg lyk soos 'n advertensie en voel soos 'n yskas.
rows.note: Only the Afrikaans names Joburg, and the photograph is the Joburg skyline, so the Afrikaans captions the picture.

rows.en: Joburg winter dawn: the view is free; the air charges admission.
rows.af: Joburg winterdagbreek: die uitsig is verniet; die lug vra toegangsgeld.
rows.note: Photo: a runner looking over the Joburg skyline at dawn. A caption.

rows.en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
rows.af: Welkom-koud vandag. Die soort wat deur drie truie gaan asof hulle nie daar is nie.
rows.note: A comparison (as cold as Welkom) and a pun on welkom. Photo: frosted wheelie bins at sunrise.

rows.en: The Karoo cools fast under a clear sky, but nobody has noticed yet.
rows.af: Die Karoo koel vinnig af onder 'n skoon lug, maar niemand het dit nog agtergekom nie.
rows.note: Photo: kids playing cricket in a dorp street with a windpump. Reads as the Karoo.

rows.en: The sheep bunched up an hour ago, which is the Karoo's own forecast.
rows.af: Die skape het 'n uur gelede saamgebondel, en dis die Karoo se eie voorspelling.
rows.note: Photo: sheep bunched on Karoo veld. A caption.

rows.en: Somebody left the freezer door open overnight.
rows.af: Die Karoo het die verkoeler oopgelos.
rows.note: Only the Afrikaans names a place. Photo: a hadeda on a frosty suburban lawn, not the Karoo. The tag keys on the English, so TAG also hides the English outside the Karoo. The clean fix is a new Afrikaans line, which is an Afrikaans ruling, not this page.

rows.en: The Karoo does its coldest hour right before its prettiest one.
rows.af: Die Karoo se koudste uur kom net voor sy mooiste een.
rows.note: Photo: a farmer and his sheep at a frosty Karoo dawn. A caption.

rows.en: Sunday, and the Karoo is doing the one thing it does better than anywhere.
rows.af: Sondag, en die Karoo doen die een ding wat hy beter as enige plek doen.
rows.note: Photo: a stoep facing a Karoo sunset, windpump and koppie. The line captions the picture.

rows.en: The Bo-Kaap does the colour this morning because the sky refuses to.
rows.af: Die Bo-Kaap sorg vanoggend vir die kleur, want die lug weier.
rows.note: Photo: the Bo-Kaap under cloud. A caption.

rows.en: Table Mountain gets the silhouette; the clouds get the whole colour budget.
rows.af: Tafelberg kry die silhoeët; die wolke kry die hele kleurbegroting.
rows.note: Photo: Table Mountain in silhouette across the bay. A caption.

rows.en: Friday evening, snow on the Apostles, and the only queue is for the kettle.
rows.af: Vrydagaand, sneeu op die Apostels, en die enigste tou is vir die ketel.
rows.note: Photo: hot chocolate on a balcony facing snow on the mountains above the Atlantic seaboard. A caption.

rows.en: Snow on the mountain. The kind of cold Cape Town frames and hangs on the wall.
rows.af: Sneeu op die berg. Die soort koue wat Kaapstad raam en teen die muur hang.
rows.note: Same balcony photograph, snow on the mountain above the sea. A caption.

rows.en: Frost on the lawn and wors on the grid: a Cape winter compromise.
rows.af: Ryp op die grasperk en wors op die rooster: 'n Kaapse winterkompromie.
rows.note: Photo: a frosty-night braai in front of a Cape Dutch gable. A caption.

rows.en: The fog took the city but it is not getting the Bo-Kaap's colours.
rows.af: Die mis het die stad gevat, maar die Bo-Kaap se kleure kry hy nie.
rows.note: Photo: the Bo-Kaap in fog. A caption.

rows.en: Table Mountain is right behind her and she cannot see a single bit of it.
rows.af: Tafelberg is reg agter haar en sy kan nie 'n enkele stukkie daarvan sien nie.
rows.note: Photo: a woman in the wind, Table Mountain behind her. A caption.

rows.en: Lion's Head is doing the scenery and the wind is doing the comedy.
rows.af: Leeukop sorg vir die uitsig en die wind vir die komedie.
rows.note: Photo: two women on a windy promenade, Lion's Head behind them. A caption.

rows.en: Bo-Kaap in the last light, and the wind is doing the housekeeping.
rows.af: Bo-Kaap in die laaste lig, en die wind doen die huishouding.
rows.note: Photo: the Bo-Kaap at dusk, Signal Hill behind. A caption.

rows.en: Somebody is going to come home to a lounge full of Signal Hill.
rows.af: Iemand gaan by 'n sitkamer vol Seinheuwel tuiskom.
rows.note: Same Bo-Kaap photograph; Signal Hill is in it.

rows.en: Table Mountain is right there and neither of them has looked at it once.
rows.af: Tafelberg is reg daar en nie een van hulle het een keer daarna gekyk nie.
rows.note: Photo: a couple on the beach, Table Mountain across the bay. A caption.

rows.en: Table Mountain, a braai, and a wind with its own strong opinion.
rows.af: Tafelberg, 'n braai, en 'n wind met sy eie sterk mening.
rows.note: Photo: a braai with Table Mountain behind. A caption.

rows.en: The Helderberg is clear, the washing is horizontal, and that is Sunday sorted.
rows.af: Die Helderberg is helder, die wasgoed hang horisontaal, en Sondag is gereël.
rows.note: Photo: washing on a white wall under a mountain range, the mountain the line names.

rows.en: Durban grey is still twenty-four degrees, which is why the promenade never empties.
rows.af: Durban se grys is steeds vier-en-twintig grade, en dis hoekom die promenade nooit leeg raak nie.
rows.note: Photo: a runner on a beachfront promenade by a whalebone-arch pier. A caption.

rows.en: Layer up like you're climbing Sani Pass.
rows.af: Trek lae aan asof jy Sani Pass klim.
rows.note: A comparison, not a location; it works anywhere. Photo: a mother zipping a child into a jacket.

rows.en: The N1 is now a waterpark.
rows.af: Die N1 is nou 'n waterpark.
rows.note: Photo: a rain-soaked highway jam into Cape Town, mountain behind. The N1 is a national road. If tagged, the N1 runs through western-cape, karoo, free-state and gauteng (Limpopo has no box).

rows.en: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.
rows.af: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 vergeet hoe om te bestuur.
rows.note: Same highway photograph. The N1 is a national road. If tagged, the N1 runs through western-cape, karoo, free-state and gauteng.

rows.en: The south-easter has found the one open window on the whole street.
rows.af: Die suidooster het die een oop venster in die hele straat gekry.
rows.note: Names a wind, not a place: the wind blowing where you are. Photo: the Bo-Kaap. The third southeaster line ("Weather this perfect is on loan…") is already tagged western-cape.

rows.en: The southeaster doesn’t knock. You’ll hear it under the door all night.
rows.af: Die suidooster klop nie. Jy gaan hom die hele nag onder die deur hoor.
rows.note: Names a wind, not a place: the wind blowing where you are. Photo: a Cape Town street at night. The third southeaster line is already tagged western-cape.

rows.en: The kind of day Joburg pretends it doesn't have until you're standing in it.
rows.af: Die soort dag wat Joburg voorgee hy nie het nie totdat jy daarin staan.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
rows.af: Hoëveld-winter: die enigste plek waar jy twee jasse aantrek om die pos te gaan haal.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag. The gauteng and highveld boxes are the same rectangle.

rows.en: Joburg does fog so rarely it feels like a limited edition.
rows.af: Joburg doen mis so selde dat dit soos 'n spesiale uitgawe voel.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: Joburg rains for twenty minutes, then paints the sky like nothing happened.
rows.af: Joburg reën twintig minute en verf dan die lug asof niks gebeur het nie.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.
rows.af: Die Vrystaat het pas onthou hy het 'n winter-setting.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose this.
rows.af: Karoo-oggend. Die soort wat jou laat respek hê vir elke boer wat dit gekies het.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: 7pm and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
rows.af: 19:00 en steeds 30 grade. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: Mornings like this are why Capetonians never stop mentioning it.
rows.af: Oggende soos dié is hoekom Kapenaars nooit ophou spog nie.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag. Photo: the Bo-Kaap at dawn.

rows.en: Golden hour, ice-cold air. Cape Town loves a dramatic contrast.
rows.af: Golden hour, yskoue lug. Kaapstad hou van drama.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag. Photo: a cat at a frosted window; nothing Cape Town in it.

rows.en: Cape Town just got a dimmer switch.
rows.af: Kaapstad het 'n dimmer skakelaar gekry.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.
rows.af: Die bergwind het in die nag gedraai. Kaapstad, vandag is jy Upington.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag. It speaks to Cape Town directly.

rows.en: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.
rows.af: Die Kaapse Dokter maak huisbesoeke.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag.

rows.en: Table Mountain's tablecloth is out.
rows.af: Tafelberg se tafeldoek is uit.
rows.note: Already tagged: TAG changes nothing, KEEP lifts the tag. Photo: a palm and a mountain at sunrise; no tablecloth in frame.
